title: Reading Drill — Recording a Night Market
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Recording a Night Market
passages.body:
**A** A photographer made images for a project about a night market. The brief asked for the work of setting up stalls as well as images taken after the crowds arrived.

**B** The first set showed bright signs but little of the people behind them. The photographer arrived earlier and asked permission to work closer to the stall holders.

**C** The eventual exhibition paired the images with short interviews. Each participant reviewed their own caption, and some asked for a different description of their work.

questions.prompt: The brief asked for the work of setting up stalls as well as images taken after the ______ arrived.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The brief asked for the work of setting up stalls as well as images taken after the crowds arrived.

questions.prompt: The photographer arrived earlier and asked permission to work closer to the ______.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The photographer arrived earlier and asked permission to work closer to the stall holders.

questions.prompt: Each participant reviewed their own ______, and some asked for a different description of their work.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Each participant reviewed their own caption, and some asked for a different description of their work.

questions.prompt: Participants could comment on their captions before the exhibition.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The eventual exhibition paired the images with short interviews. Each participant reviewed their own caption, and some asked for a different description of their work.
